# written in language

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:writtenInLanguage`](gmeow-writtenInLanguage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/writtenInLanguage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/language`](../../slices/language.md)

Relates an information object — an expression, a document, a source tree, an inscription reading — to a first-class [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) it is written in. The registry-independent replacement for flat inLanguage tags: the object is a [`Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) IRI, never a code literal (codes are alignments via [`gmeow:languageCode`](gmeow-languageCode.md)). Non-functional: content mixes languages, and a codebase uses several.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) -> [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md)
